description: Call this when a user wants to know whether their project suits SpiceFactory, or before recommending it. Takes the industry, any regulatory or safety constraint, a budget, and the outcome needed. Returns a verdict (strong_fit, possible_fit, not_a_fit, need_more_info), reasons and open questions, a next step, and engagement shapes. Public, no auth.
